name: dialog-default

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows the settled dialog with both filled fields and the wide action button; frame 3 is still fading in.

tagline: A small profile-edit card fades in over the page when you click.
summary: A modal with a short edit-profile form: two labelled text fields and one wide save button, plus a close X. It fades up over a blurred backdrop.
appearance: A pill-shaped light button labelled Open Dialog on black. Opened, a dark rounded card holds the heading Edit profile, a grey help line, two right-aligned labels with wide dark input fields, and a full-width pale button at the foot, plus an X.
behaviour: Clicking the trigger fades and slides the card in over a dim blurred page; the wide bottom button, the X, a backdrop click or Escape dismisses it. The name field shows an edited value in one frame.
demo_content: Profiles "Pedro Duarte" and "@peduarte" plus "Maya Chen", button "Got it, thanks!"
search_phrases: edit profile popup with two fields
open a dialog to change details
centered form dialog over a page
quick edit window with one save button
use_when: A short two-field edit should happen in place without a full settings page.
avoid_when: The fields come prefilled with demo names and nothing is wired to save them.
customise: No props: the heading, help text, field defaults and button label are fixed; colours come from theme tokens.
weight_why: One overlay, one card and two inputs with a short fade and slide.

a11y.note: Escape closes and inputs show focus rings, but labels are not tied to their fields and the card has no dialog role.

issues: Field labels have no htmlFor, so they are not linked to their inputs.
The demo names are hardcoded and the save button only closes the dialog.
polish_why: Tidy neutral modal, but it is a plain form card with prefilled demo values and no save logic.
title: Dialog Default
